notes.description: REQUIRED WHEN THERE ARE NO CHECKS. An empty list with a null note is indistinguishable from a stage that declined, could not read the templates, or ran out of budget -- all of which read as a clean interface.

checks.description: Pairs of elements worth MEASURING. This is a proposal about where to look, never a claim that they overlap: the controller measures both boxes and computes the intersection itself.

route.description: Path relative to the declared origin, beginning with '/'. It is pinned by scheme, host and port before anything is navigated; an absolute URL elsewhere is refused.

selector_a.description: A CSS selector for the first element, read off the app's own markup.

selector_b.description: A CSS selector for the second element.

why.description: What in the markup or CSS suggests these two can collide. A reason a human can check against the source without trusting anything else here.

notes.description: Anything about the stage itself: templates that could not be read, routes that could not be determined.
